note: Ready-to-use sentences for everyday life in Japan, grouped by scene and ordered from most essential to less. Every sentence follows the same pattern: a few tagged chunks, then one core at the end. The core never changes: it stays in the polite present form, and a time word like きのう (kinō) or あした (ashita) shows when things happen. There is no special question form. Say the same sentence with a rising voice and it becomes a question. Learn one sentence, then swap one chunk for your own word and you have a new one.

scenes.name: Greetings & small talk
scenes.intro: The first words you say every day. Most of these are fixed phrases you can use without changing anything.

phrases.ex: おはようございます。|Good morning.
phrases.note: With friends and family, just おはよう (ohayō).

phrases.ex: こんにちは。|Hello. / Good afternoon.
phrases.note: From late morning until evening. After dark, say こんばんは (konbanwa).

phrases.ex: ありがとうございます。|Thank you.
phrases.note: Casual: ありがとう (arigatō).

phrases.ex: すみません。|Excuse me. / Sorry.
phrases.note: Use it to call a waiter, get past someone, or say a small sorry.

phrases.ex: はじめまして。|Nice to meet you.
phrases.note: Only for the very first meeting. Follow it with your name.

phrases.ex: わたし.は ジョンです。|I'm John.
phrases.note: Swap in your own name. People often drop わたし.は (watashi wa) completely.

phrases.ex: よろしくおねがいします。|Nice to meet you. / I look forward to working with you.
phrases.note: Say it right after your name. It closes almost every introduction.

phrases.ex: おなまえ.は なんです？|What's your name?
phrases.note: Raise your voice at the end.

phrases.ex: おくに.は どこです？|Where are you from?
phrases.note: A common first question for visitors.

phrases.ex: わたし.は イギリスじんです。|I'm British.
phrases.note: Country + じん (jin): アメリカじん, フランスじん, オーストラリアじん.

phrases.ex: おげんきです？|How are you?
phrases.note: Used when you have not seen someone for a while, not as a daily hello.

phrases.ex: げんきです。|I'm fine.
phrases.note: The usual reply to おげんきです？

phrases.ex: にほんご.が すこし わかります。|I understand a little Japanese.
phrases.note: Note the tag が (ga) with わかります (wakarimasu).

phrases.ex: もういちど おねがいします。|Once more, please.
phrases.note: Your best friend when you miss something.

phrases.ex: ゆっくり おねがいします。|Slowly, please.
phrases.note: Put both together: もういちど ゆっくり おねがいします.

phrases.ex: おひさしぶりです。|Long time no see.

scenes.name: At home
scenes.intro: Japanese homes run on a set of daily phrases for leaving, coming back, eating and sleeping. Say them and you sound like family.

phrases.ex: いってきます。|I'm off. / See you later.
phrases.note: Said when you leave home. The reply is いってらっしゃい (itterasshai).

phrases.ex: いってらっしゃい。|Have a good day. / Take care.
phrases.note: Said to the person who is leaving.

phrases.ex: ただいま。|I'm home.
phrases.note: Said as you walk in the door.

phrases.ex: おかえりなさい。|Welcome home.
phrases.note: The reply to ただいま. Casual: おかえり (okaeri).

phrases.ex: トイレ.は どこです？|Where is the toilet?
phrases.note: Works in any home, shop or station.

phrases.ex: くつ.は ここ.で ぬぎます？|Do I take my shoes off here?
phrases.note: Shoes come off at the entrance in most homes.

phrases.ex: ごはんです。|Dinner's ready!
phrases.note: Lit. "It's a meal." Called out to the whole house.

phrases.ex: おふろ.に はいります。|I'm getting in the bath.
まど.を あけます。|I'll open the window.
phrases.note: Swap the core: しめます (shimemasu) = close.

phrases.ex: でんき.を けします。|I'll turn off the light.
phrases.note: Turn on: つけます (tsukemasu).

phrases.ex: かぎ.は つくえのうえ.に あります。|The key is on the desk.
phrases.note: Place words sit inside the chunk: つくえのうえ (on the desk), ドアのちかく (near the door).

phrases.ex: ごみ.は あした だします。|I'll put the rubbish out tomorrow.
phrases.note: Rubbish days are strict in Japan. The time word can also come first: あした ごみ.は だします.

phrases.ex: あした.は なんじ.に おきます？|What time are you getting up tomorrow?
テレビ.を みます。|I'm going to watch TV.
もう ねます。|I'm going to bed now.
おやすみなさい。|Good night.
phrases.note: Casual: おやすみ (oyasumi).

scenes.name: Shopping
scenes.intro: Point, ask the price, pay. With これ (kore, this one) and a few cores you can shop almost anywhere.

phrases.ex: これ.は いくらです？|How much is this?
これ.を ください。|I'll take this one, please.
phrases.note: Point and say it. The simplest way to buy anything.

phrases.ex: これ.を ふたつ ください。|Two of these, please.
phrases.note: Counting: ひとつ, ふたつ, みっつ, よっつ, いつつ (one to five).

phrases.ex: ぜんぶ.で いくらです？|How much is it altogether?
カード.は つかえます？|Can I pay by card?
phrases.note: Swap in げんきん (genkin, cash) or アイシー (IC transport card).

phrases.ex: げんきん.で はらいます。|I'll pay in cash.
ふくろ.は いりません。|I don't need a bag.
phrases.note: If you do want one: ふくろ.を ください.

phrases.ex: みているだけです。|I'm just looking.
phrases.note: A polite way to say no thanks to a shop assistant.

phrases.ex: おちゃ.は どこ.に あります？|Where is the tea?
phrases.note: Swap in anything you are looking for.

phrases.ex: もっと ちいさいの.は あります？|Do you have a smaller one?
phrases.note: Bigger: おおきいの (ōkii no).

phrases.ex: しちゃく.は できます？|Can I try it on?
ちょっと たかいです。|It's a bit expensive.
phrases.note: Cheap: やすいです (yasui desu).

phrases.ex: レジ.は どこです？|Where is the checkout?
レシート.を ください。|Can I have a receipt, please?
また きます。|I'll come again.
phrases.note: A friendly way to leave without buying.

scenes.name: Eating & drinking
scenes.intro: Restaurants, cafes and dinner at someone's home. Start and end every meal with the two fixed phrases.

phrases.ex: いただきます。|(Said before eating.)
phrases.note: Hands together, a small bow. Everyone says it, even alone.

phrases.ex: ごちそうさまでした。|Thank you for the meal. (Said after eating.)
phrases.note: Also said to the staff as you leave a restaurant.

phrases.ex: おいしいです。|It's delicious.
phrases.note: The most welcome words at any table.

phrases.ex: ふたりです。|Two people, please.
phrases.note: At the entrance, when asked how many. One: ひとりです. Three: さんにんです.

phrases.ex: メニュー.を ください。|Can I have the menu, please?
おすすめ.は なんです？|What do you recommend?
これ.を ひとつ ください。|One of these, please.
phrases.note: Point at the menu or the picture.

phrases.ex: これ.は なんです？|What is this?
おみず.を ください。|Water, please.
あついおちゃ.を ください。|Hot tea, please.
phrases.note: Cold: つめたいおちゃ (tsumetai ocha).

phrases.ex: わたし.は にく.を たべません。|I don't eat meat.
phrases.note: Swap in さかな (sakana, fish) or ぶたにく (butaniku, pork).

phrases.ex: たまごのアレルギー.が あります。|I have an egg allergy.
phrases.note: Swap in そば, こむぎ (wheat), えび (shrimp).

phrases.ex: これ.は からいです？|Is this spicy?
おかわり.を おねがいします。|Another one, please. / A refill, please.
おなか.が いっぱいです。|I'm full.
おかいけい.を おねがいします。|The bill, please.
phrases.note: In many places you pay at the register by the door.

scenes.name: Getting around
scenes.intro: Trains, buses and taxis. The tags まで (made, up to) and で (de, by means of) do most of the work here.

phrases.ex: えき.は どこです？|Where is the station?
なら.まで いくらです？|How much is it to Nara?
phrases.note: Swap in any place name.

phrases.ex: なら.まで どのくらい かかります？|How long does it take to Nara?
きっぷ.は どこ.で かいます？|Where do I buy a ticket?
このでんしゃ.は なら.に いきます？|Does this train go to Nara?
きょうとゆき.は なんばんせんです？|Which platform for Kyoto?
phrases.note: ゆき (yuki) = bound for.

phrases.ex: つぎのえき.で おります。|I get off at the next station.
えき.まで あるきます。|I'll walk to the station.
バス.で いきます。|I'll go by bus.
phrases.note: Swap in でんしゃ (train), くるま (car), じてんしゃ (bicycle).

phrases.ex: タクシー.を よんでください。|Please call a taxi.
このじゅうしょ.まで おねがいします。|To this address, please.
phrases.note: Show the driver the address on your phone.

phrases.ex: ここ.で とめてください。|Please stop here.
みち.が わかりません。|I'm lost. / I don't know the way.
ここ.は どこです？|Where am I? (lit. Where is this?)
phrases.note: Point at a map as you ask.

phrases.ex: えき.から とおいです？|Is it far from the station?
phrases.note: Close: ちかいです (chikai desu).

phrases.ex: えき.まで くるま.で むかえ.に いきます。|I'll pick you up at the station by car.
phrases.note: The chunks can move: くるま.で えき.まで むかえ.に いきます.

scenes.name: Time & plans
scenes.intro: Making plans and talking about when. The core stays the same; a time word at the front sets past or future.

phrases.ex: いま なんじです？|What time is it now?
あした.は ひまです？|Are you free tomorrow?
あした.は しごと.が あります。|I have work tomorrow.
しゅうまつ.は なに.を します？|What are you doing this weekend?
なんじ.に あいます？|What time shall we meet?
さんじ.に えき.で まちます。|I'll wait at the station at three.
phrases.note: Time uses に (ni), place of action uses で (de).

phrases.ex: らいしゅう きょうと.へ いきます。|I'm going to Kyoto next week.
きのう ともだち.と えいが.を みます。|Yesterday I saw a film with a friend.
phrases.note: Level 1 keeps the core unchanged: the word きのう (kinō) already says it was in the past.

phrases.ex: ちょっと まってください。|Please wait a moment.
すこし おくれます。|I'll be a little late.
phrases.note: Send this before you are late, not after.

phrases.ex: あとで いきます。|I'll go later.
みせ.は なんじまでです？|What time is the shop open until?
きょう.は なんようびです？|What day is it today?
たんじょうび.は いつです？|When is your birthday?
まだ じかん.が あります。|There's still time.
きょう.は じかん.が ありません。|I don't have time today.

scenes.name: At work
scenes.intro: Workplace Japanese is full of set phrases. These keep you polite without any special honorific grammar.

phrases.ex: おつかれさまです。|Thanks for your hard work.
phrases.note: The all-purpose greeting between coworkers, any time of day.

phrases.ex: よろしくおねがいします。|Thanks in advance. / I'm counting on you.
phrases.note: At the start of a job, a meeting or a request.

phrases.ex: わかりました。|Understood.
phrases.note: One of only two past-looking fixed phrases you need.

phrases.ex: ちょっと しつもん.が あります。|I have a quick question.
もういちど おしえてください。|Please tell me once more.
これ.で いいです？|Is this okay?
phrases.note: Show your work and ask.

phrases.ex: これ.は どこ.に おきます？|Where do I put this?
てつだいます。|I'll help.
てつだってください。|Please help me.
かいぎ.は なんじ.に はじまります？|What time does the meeting start?
しりょう.を メール.で おくります。|I'll send the documents by email.
きょう.は ろくじ.まで はたらきます。|I'm working until six today.
かいしゃ.へ でんしゃ.で かよいます。|I commute to the office by train.
あした.は やすみます。|I'm taking tomorrow off.
もうすこし じかん.を ください。|Please give me a little more time.
おさきにしつれいします。|Excuse me for leaving before you.
phrases.note: Said when you leave while others are still working. They answer おつかれさまです.

scenes.name: On the farm / tea field
scenes.intro: Phrases from our natural tea farm in Nara: out in the field, picking leaves and sharing a cup afterwards.

phrases.ex: ここ.は ちゃばたけです。|This is a tea field.
ここ.で おちゃ.を つくります。|We make tea here.
のうやく.は つかいません。|We don't use pesticides.
ひりょう.も つかいません。|We don't use fertilizer either.
phrases.note: The tag も (mo) means "also" or "either".

phrases.ex: このおちゃ.は なら.で つくります。|This tea is made in Nara.
ごがつ.に しんちゃ.を つみます。|We pick the new tea in May.
phrases.note: しんちゃ (shincha) = the first, freshest tea of the year.

phrases.ex: て.で ちゃば.を つみます。|We pick the tea leaves by hand.
ちゃばたけ.まで くるま.で いきます。|We'll drive to the tea field.
ながぐつ.を はいてください。|Please wear rubber boots.
へび.に きをつけてください。|Watch out for snakes.
phrases.note: Swap in はち (hachi, bees) or むし (mushi, bugs).

phrases.ex: すこし やすみます。|I'll take a short break.
おちゃ.を いれます。|I'll make some tea.
phrases.note: いれます (iremasu) = brew or pour tea.

phrases.ex: おちゃ.を どうぞ。|Here, have some tea.
phrases.note: どうぞ (dōzo) offers anything: a seat, food, the way in.

phrases.ex: しゃしん.を とってもいいです？|May I take a photo?
あめのひ.は はたけしごと.を やすみます。|On rainy days we don't work in the field.
あした.も てつだい.に きます。|I'll come and help tomorrow too.

scenes.name: Health & the doctor
scenes.intro: When you feel ill, keep it short: say what hurts with が (ga), and ask for help with ください (kudasai).

phrases.ex: たすけてください。|Help me, please!
きゅうきゅうしゃ.を よんでください。|Please call an ambulance.
phrases.note: The emergency number in Japan is 119.

phrases.ex: ぐあい.が わるいです。|I don't feel well.
あたま.が いたいです。|I have a headache.
phrases.note: Swap in おなか (stomach), のど (throat), は (tooth).

phrases.ex: ここ.が いたいです。|It hurts here.
phrases.note: Point to the spot.

phrases.ex: ねつ.が あります。|I have a fever.
きのう.から せき.が でます。|I've had a cough since yesterday.
phrases.note: から (kara) with a time word = since.

phrases.ex: びょういん.は どこです？|Where is the hospital?
かぜぐすり.を ください。|Cold medicine, please.
phrases.note: At a pharmacy (やっきょく, yakkyoku).

phrases.ex: このくすり.は いつ のみます？|When do I take this medicine?
phrases.note: Medicine is "drunk" in Japanese: のみます (nomimasu).

phrases.ex: アレルギー.が あります。|I have an allergy.
えいご.は だいじょうぶです？|Is English okay?
だいじょうぶです？|Are you okay?
だいじょうぶです。|I'm okay.
おだいじに。|Take care. / Get well soon.
phrases.note: Said to someone who is ill, and by staff as you leave a clinic.

scenes.name: Family & people
scenes.intro: Talking about family and friends. Use plain words like つま (tsuma, my wife) for your own family.

phrases.ex: かぞく.は なんにんです？|How many people are in your family?
よにんです。|Four.
phrases.note: ふたり (2), さんにん (3), よにん (4), ごにん (5).

phrases.ex: つま.と むすめ.が います。|I have a wife and a daughter.
phrases.note: Here と (to) means "and". Husband: おっと (otto). Son: むすこ (musuko).

phrases.ex: こども.は いません。|I don't have children.
むすこ.は じゅっさいです。|My son is ten.
phrases.note: Age: number + さい (sai).

phrases.ex: おこさん.は なんさいです？|How old is your child?
phrases.note: おこさん (okosan) is for someone else's child.

phrases.ex: こちら.は ともだちです。|This is my friend.
phrases.note: こちら (kochira) is the polite way to introduce someone.

phrases.ex: あのひと.は だれです？|Who is that person?
あに.は とうきょう.に すんでいます。|My older brother lives in Tokyo.
りょうしん.は アメリカ.に います。|My parents are in America.
わたし.は けっこんしています。|I'm married.
おとうさん.は おげんきです？|Is your father well?
うち.に いぬ.が います。|We have a dog at home.
phrases.note: Swap in ねこ (neko, cat).

phrases.ex: ともだち.と ひるごはん.を たべます。|I'm having lunch with a friend.
phrases.note: Here と (to) means "with".

phrases.ex: はは.に てがみ.を かきます。|I'll write a letter to my mother.
みんな.で しゃしん.を とります。|We'll take a photo all together.

scenes.name: Weather & seasons
scenes.intro: The weather is the easiest small talk in Japan. Adjective + です (desu) is all you need.

phrases.ex: きょう.は いいてんきです。|It's nice weather today.
あついです。|It's hot.
さむいです。|It's cold.
きょう.は むしあついです。|It's hot and humid today.
あめ.が ふっています。|It's raining.
あした.は あめです。|It's going to rain tomorrow.
phrases.note: Swap in はれ (hare, sunny) or くもり (kumori, cloudy).

phrases.ex: かさ.は あります？|Do you have an umbrella?
かさ.を かしてください。|Could you lend me an umbrella?
かぜ.が つよいです。|The wind is strong.
たいふう.が きます。|A typhoon is coming.
あめ.は あした.まで つづきます。|The rain will continue until tomorrow.
ゆき.が ふります。|It's going to snow.
はる.は さくら.が きれいです。|In spring the cherry blossoms are beautiful.
ならのなつ.は あついです。|Summer in Nara is hot.
どのきせつ.が すきです？|Which season do you like?
わたし.は あき.が すきです。|I like autumn.
phrases.note: はる (spring), なつ (summer), あき (autumn), ふゆ (winter).

scenes.name: Phone & messages
scenes.intro: Phone calls and messaging apps. On the phone, speak a little slower and don't be shy to ask for a repeat.

phrases.ex: もしもし。|Hello? (on the phone)
phrases.note: Only for the phone, never face to face.

phrases.ex: スミスです。|This is Smith.
phrases.note: Just your name + です when you call or answer.

phrases.ex: たなかさん.は います？|Is Mr. Tanaka there?
よく きこえません。|I can't hear you well.
もうすこし おおきいこえ.で おねがいします。|A little louder, please.
いま でんしゃのなかです。|I'm on the train right now.
phrases.note: People don't talk on the phone on trains. Say this and call back.

phrases.ex: あとで かけなおします。|I'll call you back later.
あとで また でんわします。|I'll call again later.
でんわばんごう.を おしえてください。|Please tell me your phone number.
ライン.は やっています？|Are you on LINE?
phrases.note: LINE is the messaging app most people in Japan use.

phrases.ex: メッセージ.を おくります。|I'll send you a message.
しゃしん.を ライン.で おくります。|I'll send the photo on LINE.
メール.で おくってください。|Please send it by email.
へんじ.を まっています。|I'm waiting for your reply.
バッテリー.が すくないです。|My battery is low.
しつれいします。|Goodbye. (Polite way to end a call.)
phrases.note: Also used when entering or leaving a room.
